Practical Home Projects

Project Overview

I frequently identify quick fixes to simple problems within my household. With my prototyping skills I can quickly sketch up an idea and have a solution ready within hours.

Skills Used

Reverse Engineering Failure Analysis 3D CAD Modelling Multi Part Assembly Design for Additive Manufacturing

Custom Headphone Holder


Designed specifically for the thickness of my desk, features a honeycomb hole design to save material and a modern, chamfered aesthetic.

Reverse Engineered Music Stand Part


When the mechanism that fixed my music stand at a certain height broke, I figured out that the threads on the bolt were worn out. After discovering that the part was a standard M4 bolt, I used my own bolt and designed a quick thumb screw adaptor.

Model Aircraft Stand


Instead of buying a stand for my model Concorde, I modelled a stand that I could 3D print. The design includes two friction fit parts that display the model at an angle.

Bird Feeder CAD Competition


I designed and modelled a bird feeder in CAD for a school competition that I entered and won. The design utilises an upcycled bottle that is filled with bird feed and inverted, the feed automatically dispenses through the holes.

Room Design


When redecorating my bedroom, I had an idea for a custom desk combined with a flat-pack shelving unit. I measured the dimensions of my room and the existing shelving unit and modelled my idea in CAD, I then communicated my design with a local carpenter who worked with my design to build the desk.
